story: New York led by 19 in the third, then didn't score again after Bridges' corner three. Minnesota got within 102–99, and LaMelo Ball missed a tying three with 9.9 seconds left.
aria: Animated Short: Mikal Bridges' 3-pointer from the right corner off a pass from OG Anunoby with 3:26 left that made it 102–93, the Knicks' last points. Knicks win 102–99 at Minnesota. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
